description: Source code implementing CUDA-aware allreduce operations for distributed processing in PyTorch, including classes for device and host work, sparse tensor handling, and factory functions for creating work objects.

classes.name: AsyncAllreduceCUDADeviceWork
classes.description: Handles CUDA device-side allreduce work, utilizing Gloo's ring chunked algorithm.

classes.name: AsyncAllreduceCUDAHostWork
classes.description: Handles host-side allreduce work with CUDA tensors, managing stream synchronization and data transfer.

classes.name: AsyncSparseAllreduceCUDAWork
classes.description: Handles sparse tensor allreduce on CUDA, including coalescing and copying back to CUDA tensors.

methods.name: createAlgorithm
methods.description: Creates a Gloo algorithm for allreduce based on tensor type.

methods.name: getInputTensors
methods.description: Returns input tensors involved in the operation.

methods.name: makeAllreduceCUDAWork
methods.description: Factory function to create appropriate CUDA allreduce work object based on tensor layout.
